tools.name: project_status
tools.summary: Inspect public requirements or a fresh check's paged tests/findings. item_id filters findings by exact object UUID; stale object locations are withheld.

tools.name: new_project
tools.summary: Create design intent; prepared libraries are retained. Dimensions in mm, even copper layers.

tools.name: add_component
tools.summary: Add a disconnected component. Legacy pin metadata cannot define connectivity.

tools.name: remove_component
tools.summary: Remove a component; outstanding interface/power requirements stay visible.

tools.name: add_net
tools.summary: Declare a net and its electrical properties explicitly.

tools.name: remove_net
tools.summary: Remove an unused net declaration; connected pins must be disconnected first.

tools.name: rename_net
tools.summary: Rename a net and all typed references without changing connectivity.

tools.name: connect_pin
tools.summary: Connect a pin; remove its NC marker, reject unknown declared nets.

tools.name: disconnect_pin
tools.summary: Disconnect a pin without declaring that leaving it open is intentional.

tools.name: add_no_connect
tools.summary: Mark an already disconnected pin intentionally NC; never cut a wire silently.

tools.name: set_component_value
tools.summary: Update value; datasheet/functional checks must be rerun.

tools.name: assign_footprint
tools.summary: Assign a CAD footprint; optional pin-to-pad map must be explicit.

tools.name: add_power_symbol
tools.summary: Add a schematic-only power symbol/PWR_FLAG after verifying the supply path.

tools.name: set_net_rule
tools.summary: Set per-net geometry constraints; widths and spacings are in mm.

tools.name: set_requirements
tools.summary: Set model intent/diagnostics for constraints, postroute, acquisition or analysis; power_tree/interfaces use {items:[...]}. Bound public task requirements stay authoritative.

tools.name: generate_schematic
tools.summary: Generate board.kicad_sch and project tables from saved intent. Explicit overwrite archives old files and invalidates checks.

tools.name: view_design
tools.summary: Render current native schematic and top PCB views with source/image hashes; MCP delivers images only when the controller enables vision. Partial views are not acceptance.

tools.name: inspect_schematic
tools.summary: Read complete revision-bound sheet objects in mm. Follow next_call for remaining objects; ref/UUID/kind filters cover only their query, never the whole sheet.

tools.name: place_schematic_component
tools.summary: Move/rotate one existing schematic unit and its attached endpoints; preserve UUIDs and netlist or reject atomically. Board placement is separate.

tools.name: set_schematic_field
tools.summary: Set one schematic field's drawing pose/visibility without changing its value or connectivity.

tools.name: set_schematic_wire
tools.summary: Create or replace one schematic wire segment with two endpoints in mm; rerun ERC and netlist parity after connectivity edits.

tools.name: remove_schematic_item
tools.summary: Remove one native wire/label/junction/NC marker by UUID; circuit intent is unchanged, so ERC and parity must be rerun.

tools.name: set_schematic_label
tools.summary: Create or replace one label for a declared net at an actual wire/pin anchor; rerun ERC and netlist parity.

tools.name: verify_schematic
tools.summary: Fresh ERC, exact netlist, footprints, structural rules and declared electrical checks; missing datasheets remain UNKNOWN.

tools.name: generate_pcb
tools.summary: Freshly gate schematic, then generate unrouted PCB and explicit project rules. Missing electrical evidence requires task-authorized CAD-only reason; FAIL always blocks. Overwrite archives old PCB.

tools.name: update_pcb
tools.summary: Sync the schematic while retaining existing-net copper and footprint poses for local repair. True explicitly removes all tracks/vias on affected nets; orphan-net copper is always removed. Rerun DRC after ECO.

tools.name: inspect_board
tools.summary: Read native board geometry. Use collection for complete revision-bound pages, bounds_mm=[[xmin,ymin],[xmax,ymax]] for envelope filtering, item_id for a UUID. inspect_tool documents type-specific output; geometry is not connectivity.

tools.name: configure_component
tools.summary: Set explicit component properties; symbol changes preserve connected/NC pin numbers or reject, requiring renewed electrical review.

tools.name: lookup_component
tools.summary: Read sourced exact-MPN facts; CAD name hits alone do not qualify a part.

tools.name: prepare_component
tools.summary: Stage exact symbol, footprint, source PDFs and reviewed facts; never publish.

tools.name: bind_model
tools.summary: Bind one exact-MPN component to an installed, requalified model; preserve bytes, terminal order and hashes.

tools.name: qualify_component
tools.summary: Validate immutable artifacts, source review, resolved pins and real CAD loading.

tools.name: install_component
tools.summary: Requalify then atomically publish a new library root; never overwrite.

tools.name: create_symbol
tools.summary: Create an unqualified workspace symbol draft using validated pin geometry.

tools.name: add_symbol_pin
tools.summary: Append one pin to a staged symbol, rejecting duplicate numbers and malformed data.

tools.name: create_footprint
tools.summary: Create an unqualified workspace footprint draft using validated pad geometry.

tools.name: add_footprint_pad
tools.summary: Append one pad to a staged footprint, rejecting duplicate pad numbers.

tools.name: update_symbol_pin
tools.summary: Replace one draft pin's complete definition while preserving its number; requalification required.

tools.name: remove_symbol_pin
tools.summary: Remove one draft symbol pin by number; installed CAD and existing boards are not edited.

tools.name: update_footprint_pad
tools.summary: Replace one draft pad's complete geometry while preserving its number; requalification required.

tools.name: remove_footprint_pad
tools.summary: Remove one unambiguous draft pad by number; installed CAD and existing boards are not edited.

tools.name: discover_artifacts
tools.summary: Read bounded public HTML and retain link evidence; never execute scripts.

tools.name: fetch_artifact
tools.summary: Download a missing CAD file or datasheet with provenance; do not install it blindly.

tools.name: read_datasheet
tools.summary: Read bounded PDF pages from a downloaded or staged datasheet; return retained-file hash, not interpreted facts.

tools.name: run_analysis
tools.summary: Run fixed requirement tests by default; basis=candidate runs optional design diagnostics without changing acceptance. stage=schematic defers PCB-bound analyses.

tools.name: inspect_tool
tools.summary: Return a public tool contract or analysis/power_tree/interfaces schema without reading implementation source.

tools.name: list_references
tools.summary: List the allowlisted PCB skill references with byte sizes and SHA-256 hashes; no filesystem scan is needed.

tools.name: read_reference
tools.summary: Read a bounded allowlisted PCB skill reference; use this instead of recursive filesystem searches.

tools.name: add_track
tools.summary: Lay one straight copper segment. Returns the created track.

tools.name: add_arc
tools.summary: Add one native copper arc through three points; retain its UUID and rerun DRC.

tools.name: add_via
tools.summary: Persist one through via, dimensions in mm; explicit diameter must exceed drill.

tools.name: unroute
tools.summary: Delete tracks and vias -- all of them, or just one net's. Zones stay.

tools.name: place_component
tools.summary: Set placement intent; regeneration invalidates old routing.

tools.name: lock_component
tools.summary: Lock/unlock placement intent.

tools.name: remove_board_item
tools.summary: Remove one track, via, zone, keepout or annotation by UUID; use set_board_outline for Edge.Cuts.

tools.name: set_track_width
tools.summary: Change one track's width in mm using its UUID; vias and zones are rejected.

tools.name: set_pad_zone_connection
tools.summary: Change one placed copper pad's zone connection by UUID on the observed board revision; refill zones and rerun DRC and affected analyses afterward.

tools.name: set_component_text
tools.summary: Position one PCB reference/value field in absolute mm, with text height/angle/visibility; preserve component placement and copper.

tools.name: set_board_outline
tools.summary: Set one closed straight polygon in mm in intent and existing PCB; replaces all Edge.Cuts including cutouts.

tools.name: set_layer_count
tools.summary: Set native copper layer count; workspace tools validate range and existing copper.

tools.name: add_zone
tools.summary: Add one copper zone polygon in mm; fill_zones and verification are required.

tools.name: add_keepout
tools.summary: Add one copper-layer rule area forbidding tracks, vias and pours inside a polygon in mm.

tools.name: add_text
tools.summary: Add one annotation in mm on a non-copper, non-Edge.Cuts layer.

tools.name: fill_zones
tools.summary: Do NOT fill zones from a headless script by default.

tools.name: route_differential_pair
tools.summary: Route one pair along an explicit corridor. terminals={p:[ref:pad,ref:pad],n:[ref:pad,ref:pad]}; offset endpoints must match native pad centers.

tools.name: tune_length
tools.summary: Tune an unbranched two-pad net by replacing one straight segment. Target is total copper centerline length; pitch/amplitude in mm. Final DRC/analysis required.

tools.name: route_board
tools.summary: Export DSN, run Freerouting, import SES, fill zones and run native DRC.

tools.name: checkout_board
tools.summary: Continue a retained route/history PCB as an unverified working version; exact hashes and unchanged non-board inputs required. Returns a rollback candidate.

tools.name: run_drc
tools.summary: Run full official DRC including all unconnected and parity errors.

tools.name: run_erc
tools.summary: Run official ERC; return UNKNOWN when no fresh valid report was produced.

tools.name: export_netlist
tools.summary: Export and parse KiCad XML netlist, with source fingerprint.

tools.name: compare_schematic_pcb
tools.summary: Export the schematic, compare every physical pin/pad/net and component.

tools.name: check_component_datasheet
tools.summary: Compare declared MPN/pins/package to supplied, source-backed datasheet facts.

tools.name: check_power_tree
tools.summary: Check explicit rail voltages, load ranges, current budgets and dropout.

tools.name: check_interface
tools.summary: Check exact interface pin mapping and supplied voltage ranges/requirements.

tools.name: check_footprints
tools.summary: Load symbols/footprints and validate explicit pin-to-pad assignments.

tools.name: add_sheet
tools.summary: Add one child schematic sheet after its parent exists; root / is implicit.

tools.name: remove_sheet
tools.summary: Remove one empty leaf sheet; first move its components and remove scoped nets.

tools.name: assign_sheet
tools.summary: Move one component's schematic units to a declared sheet; PCB placement is separate.

tools.name: set_sheet_port
tools.summary: Define one explicit parent/child hierarchical port for a declared global intent net.

tools.name: verify_design
tools.summary: Fresh final ERC/DRC, exact parity, electrical facts and declared postroute checks; scoped UNKNOWN is not global PASS.

tools.name: export_project
tools.summary: Export a fresh verified CAD/Gerber/drill/BOM/placement bundle to a new project directory; file export and physical production readiness remain separate.

tools.name: save_project_copy
tools.summary: Copy native CAD and portable dependencies under a requested project name; permits unfinished candidates, never asserts verification or manufacturing readiness.

tools.name: prepare_3d_model
tools.summary: Acquire one footprint's assigned 3D bodies with provenance; standard KiCad paths use pinned upstream, custom sources need hashes. No dimensional qualification is inferred.

tools.name: export_3d
tools.summary: Export one native KiCad assembly file or PNG view. View/size apply only to PNG; 64–4096 pixels. Missing bodies remain UNKNOWN; clearance/collision requires mechanical analysis.

tools.name: finalize_claims
tools.summary: Submit scoped statuses and optional test_id/conditions_sha256 citations to fresh passing tests. Free-text engineering statements remain unverified; fixed requirements are authoritative.

tools.name: search_components
tools.summary: Search installed symbols and footprints; name hits are not datasheet qualification.

tools.name: inspect_symbol
tools.summary: Resolve actual library pin declarations for a fully qualified symbol; no inferred MPN ratings.

tools.name: run_python
tools.summary: Sandboxed Python calculation. Candidate files are read-only; write derived data only under PCB_EXTENSION_SCRATCH.
